global: Spicy reddish-orange broth, speckled with sesame seeds, swirls around noodles and chashu pork. Served in a white ceramic bowl with subtle speckles, on a dark brown tray with glossy finish.

regions.background: Dark brown tray with smooth, slightly reflective surface and subtle glossy finish.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with subtle speckles, smooth surface, and slightly uneven rim.
regions.soup: The spicy broth is reddish-orange, glossy, and speckled with sesame seeds, swirling around noodles and toppings.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with a slightly glistening surface and irregular, cooked edges.
